name: layout11
description: Vintage editorial Pinterest collage with a warm beige and cream color palette, scrapbook moodboard aesthetic, and soft retro fashion photography composition. Background features a faded sepia-toned vintage urban street photograph layered beneath bold oversized editorial typography ('LIVE LIFE WITH FASHION') and flowing cursive script accents ('be you, do you, for you'). The layout contains photo slots arranged around a large left-side full-body cutout subject with a white scalloped lace-style outline effect. On the right side: one portrait photo in the upper section showing upper body, one close-up detail shot in the middle section, and one side/back view portrait in the lower section — all framed with clean white borders and subtle drop shadows. Decorative elements include vintage sewing buttons in muted beige tones, dried botanical flowers, delicate lace ribbon trim along the edges, a small brand label ('HASFLO') with serif tagline text in the lower-left, and oversized textured exclamation mark graphics in the lower-right corner. The overall mood is warm, soft, vintage-romantic, and editorial — reminiscent of a fashion magazine scrapbook spread with a handcrafted feel. Soft diffused lighting, modest fashion aesthetic, Pinterest moodboard style. Follow the exact number, shape, scale hierarchy, and arrangement of photo slots shown in the layout reference.
swipe_cta: Add a small handwritten-style or cursive script label containing a short swipe-related CTA (such as 'Swipe →' or a similar concise variation), styled to match the existing cursive 'Swipe →' element already present in the lower-right corner of the layout. Keep the wording brief and elegant. Integrate it naturally with the vintage lace trim, dried botanical accents, and editorial scrapbook aesthetic of the layout.
